forms.notes: The hold sits inside an existing mountain: halls and tunnels carved into the rock with the entrance in the mountainside. Needs a carved-interior block.

plan.notes: Buildings are laid out as a street village for now; carving them into the mountain waits for an interior-carving block.

waits.words: Carving the halls and tunnels into the mountain rock, with the entrance in the mountainside: Architect has no underground or carved-interior block yet. The buildings are laid out first and the carving is offered when the block exists.

answer.summary: Deepforge Hold is planned as one zone of 13 buildings: a great hall, a grand forge, two smaller smithies, a mine head, a smelter, four dwarf homes, barracks, a mead hall and a mountain gate, in a pending dwarven style. Carving it inside the mountain can't be built yet, so that part waits and blocks approval until Architect supports it.
